title: helm(private): stabilize values schema + templating for init hooks and upgrade/rollback behavior
author: Aisha Kapoor
description: This PR stabilizes the Helm chart values schema and improves templating for init jobs and lifecycle hooks used by Redwood Private deployments. Motivation: customers saw inconsistent behavior during upgrades where init hooks could race with post-upgrade validation, and template rendering for KMS/nodeselector/tolerations combinations was causing schema validation failures in the private installer. Changes in this PR: add explicit values.schema.json coverage for the encryption/kms and nodeAffinity/tolerations blocks; introduce templating helpers to deduplicate tolerations and nodeSelector logic; add deterministic ordering for init job creation to avoid race conditions during upgrade; introduce a pre-upgrade backup hook and a post-upgrade validation job with configurable timeout and failurePolicy; document the rollback-compatible behavior and add an explicit opt-in flag for enabling strict schema validation during helm upgrade. Testing: included helm unit tests (helm template + kubeval checks) and an upgrade/rollback e2e run in the perf-canary cluster. Checklist: - values.schema.json updated and validated - templating helpers added and unit-tested - init hook ordering implemented (pre-upgrade backup -> drain check -> init jobs -> post-upgrade validation) - docs updated with upgrade/rollback guidance - added backward-compatible default for strict_validation (false) Links: Linear ENG-2145 (upgrade stability), ENG-2199 (helm schema hardening).
commits: feat(helm): add values.schema.json entries for kms/encryption and nodeAffinity/tolerations
refactor(helm): move common tolerations/nodeSelector templating to _helpers.tpl
fix(helm): ensure init job names use deterministic suffix to preserve ordering
chore(docs): add upgrade/rollback section to charts/private/README.md

Miguel Torres: Noted that the pre-upgrade backup hook should be idempotent and requested adding a lockfile check to avoid concurrent backups; asked CI to run upgrade e2e in perf-canary.
Aisha Kapoor: Implemented lockfile check and re-ran the canary e2e; attach run id in comment.
Jonah Reed: Approved after verifying kubeval/helm template outputs and the new schema covers the previous failure cases.
CI Bot: helm-lint failed on first run due to missing helper import; subsequent push fixed it and CI passed.
merge_outcome: Merged via squash after 2 approvals and successful CI runs
release_notes: Stabilize Helm values schema for Private deployments; improve init-hook ordering and add pre-upgrade backup and post-upgrade validation hooks. Backward-compatible by default (strict_validation=false).
